text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accusary.

- Macedonian President Kiro Gligorov will have a 40-minute meeting with U.S. President Bill Clinton in Washington. Gligorov will visit the Pentagon and the World Bank during his official visit to the U.S.
- The value of the German mark in Macedonia is the same as a month ago because offer of hard currency is constantly higher than demand. The mark costs 26,80 denars at the offficial exchange rate.
- Depositors of collapsed financial institution TAT will block access roads to Bitola on Monday.
- Four people in Dorjran were infected by brucelossis. Sale of sheep cheese in Bitola was halted because of the danger of spread of the disease.

- Due to the inclusion of the television subscription fees into the electricity bill practically no one pays electricity in Stip and Prilep. Only 0.69 percent of the May bills have been paid in Stip and 0.6 percent in Prilep. -- Mircela Casule, Skopje newsroom +381 11 222 4305
